## Change and reason

Describe the user-facing result and scope. Link any issue; do not include private knowledge.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests run are listed with actual results and explicit skips/blockers.
- [ ] Source, frozen app, native behavior and live-provider evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] Documentation and Unreleased changes reflect implementation, not requested scope.
- [ ] Human approval, revision checks, permissions and disclosure boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, live knowledge, raw logs or private fixtures are included.
- [ ] Dependency/license and migration impacts were checked where applicable.

Commands/results:

## Remaining risks

State limitations and any release gates not exercised. Independent review is welcome when available; this template does not invent a mandatory second maintainer.
